agent.notes: Workload covers: open_album on an existing index (autoscan=False) and on empty albums (autoscan=True); AssetLoaderWorker._build_payload_chunks for 50 to 10k rows with three filters plus a mid-stream cancel (base single pass vs head LIMIT 100 then OFFSET); IndexStore.read_geometry_only with and without limit/offset (base raises TypeError, caught and recorded as 'unsupported'); the offscreen-Qt AppFacade.open_album path (the head's background pairing runs in a QThreadPool thread, and the asset list model inserts rows in batches); SpacerProxyModel.data; and an album with a blocked manifest.bak backup folder that triggers the head's background-pairing error path. Head coverage 0.80, base 0.93. 12 head lines (PairingWorker.run, sync_metadata) run in Qt pool threads that coverage cannot trace; 3 (the pair=True branch of open_album) are unreachable from base; 3 (the store.count() failure fallback) would need an artificial database failure; 1 is an untriggered error-only exception path. Outputs differ legitimately: head defers pairing (rowCount 120 vs 116 in the blocked album, plus an error message) and supports limit/offset. Base runs take about 9s wall time for about 3.4s of CPU; the cause of the gap was not identified.
